d: Pradhanmantri Narendra Modi ke 21 navanbar ko Nitish Setu ke udghatan ke bad bihar ke vaishali sthit raghopur se postar pharne ka vidiyo samne aaya hai. vidiyo men kuchh yuvak RJD ke jhande lekar NDA netaon ke postar aur bainar pharte tatha Lalu Prasad Yadav aur Tejashwi Yadav ke samarthan men nare lagate dikhaee de rahe hain. is ghatna ko lekar BJP aur JDU ne RJD par nishana sadha hai. vahin, RJD ki or se ise virodh pradarshan bataya gaya hai. pulis ke anusar, mamle men tin yuvkon ko hirasat men liya gaya hai. dekhie Nitish Setu par hue is hangame ki puri kahani.
